title: pi-tools-switch configuration
description: Configuration for the pi-tools-switch extension: user-defined presets, default preset, tool guide system prompt, subagent environment variables, and custom gating modes. Loaded from <agentDir>/tools-switch.json.

presets.description: User-defined tool presets. Keys are preset names matching [a-z][a-z0-9_-]*; values are lists of built-in tool names. Presets with the same name override built-in presets.

defaultPreset.description: Name of the preset to activate automatically at session start. Skipped when running inside a subagent.

enabled.description: When true, injects the tool guide system prompt into every agent interaction (default: true).

subagentEnvVars.description: Additional environment variable names that mark a subagent context. Default preset activation is skipped when any of these (or any built-in subagent env var) is present in the environment.

gatingModes.description: User-defined gating modes. Keys are mode names. Each mode defines a trigger prefix, explicitly allowed tools, and allowed write directories. Modes with the same name override built-in modes.

trigger.description: Input prefix that activates the mode. Matched against raw input text before skill/template expansion.

allowTools.description: Tools explicitly allowed while the mode is active. Tools listed here bypass all other restrictions.

allowWriteDir.description: Directories where write/edit are allowed while the mode is active. Accepts absolute paths, paths relative to cwd, and ~-prefixed home paths. Empty or undefined blocks all write/edit.
